events.title: DEMO OUT NOW!
events.summary: Hi dice goblins! Today I'm so excited to announce that the official demo of Roll for Order: Sort Every set is now AVAILABLE! You'll get to sort 328 dice, 41 sets of dice of 5 different categories! You'll be able to pick from 5 classes: Squire: No active abilities, passive increased movement speed and increased backpack capacity. events.title: Demo coming on October 8th!

As said in our previous devblog the demo will introduce new mechanics such as golden keys to unlock dice cabinets, audio cassettes you can find to unlock new music and 'the squire' a new powerless class but with a bigger inventory. events.title: Roll for Order - Officially Announced!
events.summary: Hi everyone! We're really excited to share the announcement of 'Roll for Order' with all of you! This game is a love letter to all 'sorting' games but we wanted to add our little own twist to the genre. If you like to collect dices, you like the 1980s vibes, we strongly believe you are going to love Roll for Orders! It's a cozy first-person sorting game set in a cluttered 1980s basement.
